summary: TFP追赶非自动兑现:增长长期靠资本深化、投资效率下降,近年增速已明显放缓;脱钩、国进民退与制度约束可能压制TFP。『收敛空间』只是潜在,历史上多数中等收入经济体未兑现追赶——失败情形真实存在。

evidence.title: DOC-0009
evidence.quote: China's ICOR has been on an upward trend since the 1990s, indicating a decline in investment efficiency.

evidence.title: DOC-0012
evidence.quote: Since 1990, China has averaged breakneck GDP growth of almost 9 percent per year, at times peaking at over 14 percent.
